text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан enjoys a splendid victory at
the
Arima Kinen. Бива Хаяхидэ is blown
away by her
younger sister's
performance and expresses her

admiration.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган asserts that she'll win
next time
in no uncertain terms. Biwa
Hayahide says the
same—it seems there
is no shortage of
competitors to face.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан is far from satisfied.
Thinking of the
future and competing
against the next generation
of racers,
she has a tremendous urge to run.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
